title: Joe Oliver at the Dreamland and other Chicago musicians
summary: In Chicago in 1922 he saw Oliver at the Dreamland Cabaret and met Richard M. Jones, and mentions Al Morgan and others who left for Chicago and New York.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: That you would remember such as Joe Oliver.
